heroSubtitle: Frontend Web Developer | Informatics Engineering Student
heroDescription: I focus on building responsive, user-centered web interfaces. I also possess foundational Backend knowledge (PHP, Laravel, MySQL), allowing me to seamlessly integrate frontend interfaces with server-side logic and data.
aboutSubtitle: Educational background and skill development focus
aboutBio1: I am an undergraduate Informatics Engineering student at Universitas Dr. Soetomo with a strong passion for information technology and web development.
aboutBio2: Currently, I am focused on strengthening my Frontend Development skills using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and CSS frameworks such as Bootstrap. At the same time, I am actively learning the fundamentals of Backend Development to gain a comprehensive understanding of web architecture.
aboutBio3: My long-term goal is to grow into a competent Full Stack Developer. I am eager to gain professional internship experience in the industry and expand my network with fellow technology practitioners.
aboutBio4: Beyond technical skills, I also actively develop soft skills such as communication, teamwork, and time management. I believe the combination of hard skills and soft skills is the key to success in the tech industry.
skillsSubtitle: Technologies and tools I am currently learning and mastering
projectsSubtitle: A collection of web projects I have developed and am currently building during my learning journey
journeySubtitle: The milestones of my skill development from academia to the industry
step1Desc: Started my education at Universitas Dr. Soetomo. Here I learned programming logic, data structures, and algorithms — the foundation of my journey in tech.
step2Desc: Explored modern web development fundamentals — HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript ES6+, and Bootstrap 5. Focused on building responsive and user-centric interfaces.
step3Desc: Applied my knowledge through academic projects and self-paced practice — from e-commerce, ordering systems, to note-taking apps. Here I practiced DOM manipulation, data processing, and UI design.
step4Desc: Currently diving into server-side programming with PHP, Laravel framework, and MySQL database management — to understand web architecture as a whole.
